checks.title: Copy against the profile's banned phrases and claims policy
Designed error pages with a next step
Health endpoint exists and shows a failure path (static)
Fonts and palette against the deny-list of generic defaults
One h1 and no skipped heading levels per screen
Spacing and type size on the declared scales
Claimed features have a matching route
No stub or placeholder content on shipped surfaces
Empty, error and unavailable state wording on list screens (presence only)
Privacy notice and terms present, real and linked
Focus indicators not removed; no positive tabindex (static)
Token pair contrast (WCAG 2.2) on both themes
Values drawn from design tokens rather than hard-coded

evidence.detail: 288 user-facing string(s) scanned against 6 banned phrase(s) of profile dot-ecosystem; 3 string(s) trip a banned phrase or an unsupported-claim pattern (claim hits are listed under d6.claim_lint).
0 of 1 error statuses (404) have a custom page with a link or button. No Laravel views found: only 404 was checked. Rendering with the right status needs a running app and is not measured.

4 of 4 fonts/palette values are off the deny-list. Fonts found: IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Condensed, IBM Plex Mono, Material Symbols Rounded; the profile writes no hex colour in its prohibited list, so the palette was not evaluated. Matching is by name only.

6 of 8 screens have exactly one <h1> and no skipped level; 7 layout(s) and page(s) that rely on a layout were left out because the outline is split between files. Headings rendered by components or inserted by scripts are not seen.
33 of 33 navigation links are within 3 level(s) (engine default bound; the profile declares none) across 7 <nav> landmark(s). Click paths through pages are not measured.
0 of 5 motion declarations are covered by prefers-reduced-motion (no global override); utility classes counted per element. Motion from JavaScript is not scanned.
10 of 47 checkable internal links resolve; 12 link(s) could not be judged statically and are not counted. No routes/ directory: links were matched to files.
15 of 15 surfaces with static text are free of visible stub content. Surfaces whose text is all dynamic, and text produced by scripts, are not seen.

288 user-facing string(s) scanned; 3 carry a claim or figure and 3 of them are unsupported. Profile dot-ecosystem: 4 claims_policy rule(s), 2 with no pattern detector (no-certainty-theatre, no-unbuilt-features).

0 of 6 conditions hold (privacy and terms: present, not a placeholder, linked from shared markup). "Reachable from every public page" is approximated by a link in a layout, footer or partial; content served from a database or a CMS is not seen.
2 of 2 outline removals or positive tabindex uses are safe (replaced by a visible indicator); the rest are listed. Rendered focus order and indicator visibility are not measured.

30/34 form fields labelled (reusable component files are skipped: their consumer supplies the label), 11/11 images with alt, 9/9 documents with lang; 0 element(s) with dynamic attributes and all components were skipped. Title, name, iframe, viewport and ARIA findings do not change this share.

15 of 15 pair/theme combinations meet their threshold (4.5:1 text; 3:1 large text and focus indicators); themes evaluated: light; pair sources: ground 7, usage 8; 7 combination(s) undetermined and not counted; translucent backgrounds are undetermined; panel backgrounds are tokens named bg/panel/surface/card/sunken.

155 of 453 values come from tokens: colour 155 token / 32 literal / 0 framework-default utility; spacing and type size 0 token / 266 literal; 64 font-family declaration(s) not counted. The profile cites no token source, so any declared custom property counts.

domain_overrides.reason: A calm or reassuring tone must never soften a safety, regulatory or loss-of-money alert. The alert wins.
Distinctive colour, type and motion yield to contrast, visible focus and reduced motion.
Demonstrated value never overrides correctness: a polished wrong figure is worse than no figure.
A faster first result must not skip identity verification, consent or security steps.
